title: Products never ordered together
statementMd:
Count product pairs (a.id < b.id) that never appear in the same order, as a single number `unpaired`.

Expected columns: `unpaired`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: All pairs minus pairs that co-occur; or `NOT EXISTS`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unpaired FROM products a JOIN products b ON a.id < b.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items x JOIN order_items y ON y.order_id = x.order_id WHERE x.product_id = a.id AND y.product_id = b.id);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
